auth.title: Duxtur Edu
auth.subtitle: Sign in to access your dashboard
auth.email_hint: You will get a sign-in link by e-mail and come back here.
auth.tg_instructions_3: 3. Come back here — you will be signed in automatically.
auth.error_expired: The Telegram link expired. Please try again.
auth.error_failed: Telegram sign-in failed. Open Diagnostics below for details.
auth.duxtur_first_time: This creates your Edu profile from your duxtur.org account. Already used Edu with Telegram or Google? Sign in that way and link duxtur.org in your profile instead.
auth.duxtur_failed: Could not sign in with duxtur.org.

account.title: Sign-in methods
account.intro: One person, one account. Link your duxtur.org account to sign in to both with the same profile.
account.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to duxtur.org in this browser.
account.linkable: You are signed in to duxtur.org as {{name}}. This account is not linked to an Edu account yet.
account.link_confirm_body: Your Edu account ({{method}}) will be linked to the duxtur.org account {{name}} ({{email}}). From now on "Continue as" on the sign-in page opens this Edu profile, with the same account and data as on duxtur.org.
account.linked_elsewhere: {{name}} on duxtur.org is already linked to another Edu account, so it cannot be linked to this one. Sign in to Edu with duxtur.org to open that account and unlink it there first.
account.unlink_confirm_body: Signing in with duxtur.org will no longer open this Edu profile. Its groups and results stay in it, and you can still sign in the way you do now.

errors.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to duxtur.org. Sign in there and try again.
errors.bad_origin: The request was refused. Open Edu from a duxtur.org page.
errors.invalid_id_token: Your Edu sign-in could not be verified. Sign out of Edu, sign in again and retry.
errors.edu_uid_taken: This Edu account is already linked to another duxtur.org account.
errors.portal_already_linked: This duxtur.org account already has another Edu account linked. Unlink that one first.
errors.invalid_uid: This Edu account cannot be linked.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.network: Cannot reach duxtur.org. Check your connection.
errors.server: duxtur.org is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.bad_response: duxtur.org sent an unexpected answer. Try again later.
errors.cannot_unlink: This Edu profile can only be reached through duxtur.org, so it cannot be unlinked.

account.cannot_unlink: This Edu profile was created from your duxtur.org account, so duxtur.org is its only way to sign in and it cannot be unlinked.

articles.intro: Articles for patients appear on duxtur.org under your name as a doctor. You do not need to sign in again: the editor opens right away.
articles.off_portal_body: Articles are tied to your sign-in on duxtur.org. That sign-in is not available on this address.
articles.pending_body: The portal team is checking your diploma. Articles you send now go live by themselves as soon as your profile is approved.
articles.rejected_body: You cannot write articles until the profile is approved. If this is a mistake, contact the Duxtur team.
articles.list_error: Could not load your articles. Check your connection.
articles.empty_body: Your first article appears here as soon as you send it.
articles.link_hint: This Edu account is not linked to your duxtur.org account yet. Link them, and your groups and results are available when you sign in from the portal.
articles.write_hint: The editor opens on duxtur.org. We ask for your doctor details once, when an article is ready to send.

requests.title: Teacher requests
requests.intro: People who asked for teacher access. Approve the ones you know teach; they get teacher tools right away.
requests.empty: No requests right now. New ones will appear here.
requests.error: Could not save the answer. Check your connection and try again.
requests.declined_hint: Changed your mind? Approve a declined request and the person becomes a teacher.
requests.banner: Teacher requests waiting for your answer: {{count}}

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Practice tests for your studies. Your tests are stored only on this device and work without internet.
assistant.empty_text: Import a test file (.txt or .qst) to start practising.
assistant.storage_note: Tests are stored in this browser only. Clearing site data removes them, so keep backups (Export).
assistant.delete_text: “{{title}}” and your progress will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
assistant.nothing: No usable questions were found in the file. The format is: ?question, +right answer, -wrong answer.
assistant.issue_unmarked_option: A line without a marker was taken as an answer
assistant.issue_unmarked_question: A numbered line was taken as a question
assistant.issue_inline_options: Several answers on one line were separated
assistant.filters_hint: Ticked options work as “or”: for example “unanswered” and “mistakes” together.
assistant.problem_range: Check the range: from 1 to {{max}}, “from” must not exceed “to”.
assistant.finish_text: Unanswered questions: {{n}}. Answers cannot be changed after finishing.
assistant.db_error: Could not open local storage. Reload the page or try another browser (storage may be unavailable in private mode).
assistant.session_missing: Session not found. Go back to the list of tests.
assistant.jump_missing: Question #{{n}} is not in the current list. Check the search and filters.
assistant.no_results_hint: Change the search or reset the filters.
assistant.bank_missing: Test not found. Go back to the list of tests.
